summary: SD31-W19-ULTIMATE_COMBAT: ingest thesis tested and refuted for ultimate_combat's display+not-ingested class_feature population (1095/1098 units, re-derived and reproduced by a clean guarded regen in /home/ubuntu/cargo-targets/w19-ultimate_combat -- 1498/1265/1098, byte-identical to committed docs/work-inventory.json except generated_at, 0 changed units). Root cause: Kind::ClassFeature's has_real_description check reads the raw .lst DESC: field directly (closure_has_real_description); corpus_json_has_real_description only walks equipment/spell kinds, never class_feature -- so ingesting data/corpus/ JSON for a class_feature record is invisible to the classifier. Promotion requires an engine holds-check (class_feature_effect_wired consumer-delta probe, structurally impossible for zero-magnitude records, or an explanation-id roster match that exists only for Pathfinder Unchained via push_pu_class_feature_records). 692/1095 already have a real corpus JSON description on disk (460 real prose, 232 empty/placeholder); 403/1095 have no corpus JSON at all and trace to zero-DESC ABILITY:FEAT|VIRTUAL selection-pool plumbing rows (Monk Bonus Feat, Master of Many Styles, Kensai, Soul Forger, Skirnir, Myrmidarch) carrying no rules text in the PCGen source at all. This corroborates OPEN-ISSUES.md row 152's corpus-wide finding (the chooser-interaction primitive covers 28 pools; the corpus needs it for ~1,847) at book scale, and generalizes: books whose remaining population is dominated by class_feature archetype swaps cannot be moved by book-scoped ingest work.
